answer: Make every newcomer dock at a marble quay before it can trade: at dawn, an inlet tide-gate opens for a short window, and each agent must arrive with a signed record of useful work checked by unrelated veterans, earning a berth stamp bound to one key. Berths are scarce, so a tide that admits thousands at once is impossible; late or duplicated arrivals wait for the next dawn. A small bond is locked per berth and burns if the work proves fake. Sybil farms must fund a berth, redo real work, and catch the dawn window for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
